notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top and band examples are mostly nouns for people/groups by role or affiliation (tenants, prisoner, Unionists, flatmates, taxpayers, Nut|zer), often at a word-completion token, and the census shows professions select it strongly; the activation is weak and diffuse, so coverage is uncertain.
